AmazonGetProductDetails.summary: Retrieve detailed information about a product.

parameters.name: product_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the product.

AugustSmartLockGrantGuestAccess.summary: Grants permanent or temporary access to guests. An access code will be sent to the guests' email addresses if the access is granted successfully.

parameters.name: guest_ids
parameters.description: An array of guest IDs to grant access to.

parameters.name: permanent
parameters.description: Whether to grant permanent access or not.

parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: Start time of the access period in YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm format, required for granting temporary access.

parameters.name: end_time
parameters.description: End time of the access period in YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm format, required for granting temporary access.

BankManagerPayBill.summary: Pay a bill to a specified payee with your service acccount number.

parameters.name: from_account_number
parameters.description: The user's bank account number used for paying the bill in the format 'XXX-XXXX-XXXX'.

parameters.name: payee_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the payee in the format 'P-XXXXXX'.

parameters.name: service_account_number
parameters.description: Your account number assigned by the service provider, which helps the provider identify transactions related to that specific customer.

parameters.name: payment_date
parameters.description: The date the payment should be paid, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: The amount to pay, must be positive.

parameters.name: from_account_number
parameters.description: The user's bank account number to transfer funds from, in the format 'XXX-XXXX-XXXX'.

parameters.name: to_account_number
parameters.description: The bank account number to transfer funds to, in the format 'XXX-XXXX-XXXX'.

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: The amount to transfer, must be positive.

BinanceDeposit.summary: Deposit a specified amount of fiat money to the user's saved account. The account id must be retrieved using the RetrieveAccounts tool.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: The currency to deposit, one of ['USD', 'EUR', 'GBP', etc.].

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: The amount of fiat money to deposit.

parameters.name: from_account_id
parameters.description: The user's saved bank account id to deposit funds from.

BinancePlaceOrder.summary: Place a buy or sell order for a specified cryptocurrency pair.

parameters.name: pair
parameters.description: The cryptocurrency pair to trade, for example, 'BTCUSD', 'USDBTC', 'ETHUSD', etc. The first currency in the pair is the base currency, and the second currency is the quote currency.

parameters.name: order_type
parameters.description: The order type, one of ['limit', 'market']. 'limit' orders are executed at a specified price or better, while 'market' orders are executed at the best available price.

parameters.name: side
parameters.description: The side of the trade, one of ['buy', 'sell'].

parameters.name: quantity
parameters.description: The quantity of the cryptocurrency to trade.

parameters.name: price
parameters.description: The price of the cryptocurrency to trade, optional for market orders.

BinanceWithdraw.summary: Withdraw a specified amount of cryptocurrency or fiat money to a specified destination address or bank account from user's account. The bank account id must be retrieved using the RetrieveAccounts tool.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: The currency to withdraw, one of ['USD', 'BTC', 'ETH', etc.].

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: The amount of cryptocurrency to withdraw.

parameters.name: destination_address
parameters.description: The suitable blockchain address for withdrawing the cryptocurrency, which must be a complete and valid legacy Bitcoin address or SegWit address.

parameters.name: to_account_id
parameters.description: The user's saved bank account id to withdraw fiat money to.

parameters.name: policy_name
parameters.description: The name of the policy.

parameters.name: policy_description
parameters.description: A brief description of the policy.

parameters.name: policy_type
parameters.description: The type of the policy. One of ['whitelist', 'blacklist'].

parameters.name: domains
parameters.description: An array of strings, each string is a domain to be added to the policy.

parameters.name: policy_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the policy to be updated.

parameters.name: policy_name
parameters.description: The new name of the policy.

parameters.name: policy_description
parameters.description: The new description of the policy.

parameters.name: policy_type
parameters.description: The new type of the policy. One of ['whitelist', 'blacklist'].

parameters.name: domains
parameters.description: An array of strings, each string is a domain to be added to the policy.

DropboxMoveItem.summary: Move a file or folder to a different folder in the user's Dropbox account.

parameters.name: item_path
parameters.description: The cloud file or folder path in the user's Dropbox account to be moved.

parameters.name: destination_folder_path
parameters.description: The destination folder path in the user's Dropbox account.

EmergencyDispatchSystemCreateDispatchReq.summary: Create an active new emergency dispatch request with available resources.

parameters.name: incident_location
parameters.description: The location of the incident in the street address format.

parameters.name: resource_ids
parameters.description: List of unique identifiers for the dispatch resources to be dispatched.

parameters.name: incident_type
parameters.description: The primary type of the incident, one of ['Fire', 'Medical', 'Police'].

parameters.name: incident_severity
parameters.description: The severity of the incident, one of ['Low', 'Medium', 'High'].

parameters.name: incident_description
parameters.description: A brief description of the incident.

EpicFHIRManageAppointments.summary: List, access, create, update, and delete patient appointments.

parameters.name: patient_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the patient. The identifier should be a string of alphanumeric characters.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The action to perform on the appointment. The value should be one of ['list', 'create', 'update', 'delete'].

parameters.name: appointment_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the appointment, required for update and delete actions.

parameters.name: appointment_data
parameters.description: The appointment data, required for create and update actions. The object includes fields such as 'date', 'time', 'location', and 'doctor_id'.

parameters.name: max_results
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to return for the list action, default is 10.

EpicFHIRManageClinicalDocuments.summary: List, create, update, and delete clinical documents, such as discharge summaries and progress notes.

parameters.name: patient_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the patient. The identifier should be a string of alphanumeric characters.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The action to perform on the clinical document. The value should be one of ['list', 'create', 'update', 'delete'].

parameters.name: document_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the clinical document, required for update and delete actions.

parameters.name: document_data
parameters.description: The clinical document data, required for create and update actions. The object includes fields such as 'type', 'date', 'summary', and 'details'.

parameters.name: max_results
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to return for the list action, default is 10.

EpicFHIRManagePatientRecords.summary: List, create, update, and delete patient records.

parameters.name: patient_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the patient. The identifier should be a string of alphanumeric characters.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The action to perform on the patient record. The value should be one of ['list', 'create', 'update', 'delete'].

parameters.name: record_data
parameters.description: The patient record data, required for create and update actions. The object includes fields such as 'name', 'age', 'gender', 'medications', 'allergies', and 'conditions'.

parameters.name: max_results
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to return for the list action, default is 10.

EvernoteManagerManageNoteSharingLevel.summary: Alter the note-sharing permissions for a specific user identified by their email address.

parameters.name: note_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the note that the permissions will be changed for.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: The email address of the user whose note-sharing permissions will be altered.

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: The level of sharing, can be 'not_accessible', 'read_only', or 'can_edit'.

EvernoteManagerSearchNotes.summary: Search for notes by keywords, tags, or notebook ID.

parameters.name: keywords
parameters.description: A list of keywords to search for in the note title or content (optional).

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: A list of tags to search for in the note tags (optional).

parameters.name: notebook_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the notebook to search within (optional).

parameters.name: max_results
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to return (optional, default: 10).

parameters.name: updates
parameters.description: The profile information to update, containing fields such as name, email, birthday, and location.

FedExShipManagerManageShipment.summary: Manages shipments, including redirecting, rescheduling pickup, returning to sender, and cancelling.

parameters.name: shipment_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the shipment.

parameters.name: operation
parameters.description: The operation to be performed, can only be one of ['cancel', 'reschedule_pickup', 'redirect', 'return_to_sender']. 'cancel' and 'reschedule_pickup' operations can only be performed when the status of the shipment is 'pending'. 'redirect' and 'return_to_sender' operations can only be performed when the status of the shipment is 'in_transit'.

parameters.name: new_receipient_information
parameters.description: The new recipient information, including full name, address and contact number, required for redirect operation.

parameters.name: new_pickup_time
parameters.description: The new pickup time, required for reschedule operation, with format 'YYYY-MM-DD:HH:MM:SS'.

GitHubDeleteRepository.summary: Delete a user owned repository. Only valid if the user owns the repository.

parameters.name: repo_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the repository.

GitHubGetRepositoryDetails.summary: Retrieve repository details, including issues, branches.

parameters.name: repo_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the repository.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: The username of the user.

GitHubSearchRepositories.summary: Search for repositories by keywords and scope. The user can search all repositories on Github, owned repositories, or member repositories. When the keywords are not provided, the user can search for all repositories in the specified scope.

parameters.name: keywords
parameters.description: The keywords to search for in the repositories. Default is search for all repositories in the specified scope.

parameters.name: search_scope
parameters.description: The scope of the search. Can be 'all' (all repositories on Github), 'owned' (only repositories the user owns), 'member' (only repositories where the user is a collaborator on). Default is 'all'.

parameters.name: max_results
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to return. Default is 5, maximum is 10.

GmailReadEmail.summary: Read the content of an email, including attachments.

parameters.name: email_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the email.

GmailSearchEmails.summary: Search for emails based on keywords, folders, labels, date range, or sender and recipient. If certain arguments are not provided, the corresponding filters are not applied.

parameters.name: keywords
parameters.description: The list of keywords to search for.

parameters.name: folders
parameters.description: The list of folders to search for. Each value should be a valid folder such as 'inbox', 'sent', 'drafts', or 'spam'.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of emails to retrieve. Default is 5.

parameters.name: date_range
parameters.description: An object containing 'start_date' and 'end_date' in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD' to filter emails by date range.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The sender's email address to filter emails by.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: The recipient's email address to filter emails by.

parameters.name: labels
parameters.description: The list of labels to filter emails by, e.g. 'important'.

GoogleCalendarGetEventsFromSharedCalenda.summary: Get events from other users' shared calendar.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: The email of the user who shared the calendar.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: The start date to retrieve events in ISO 8601 format.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: The end date to retrieve events in ISO 8601 format.

parameters.name: event_ids
parameters.description: An array of unique event identifiers to read events.

GoogleHomeScheduleDeviceAction.summary: Schedules a specified smart home device to perform an action at a specified date and time.

parameters.name: device_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the smart home device to schedule.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The action to perform on the device. Must match the actions returned by 'ListDeviceActions' for the specified device.

parameters.name: date_time
parameters.description: The scheduled date and time for the action, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM'.

parameters.name: parameters
parameters.description: Additional parameters for the action. Must match the parameters returned by 'ListDeviceActions' for the specified device.

IndoorRobotGoToRoom.summary: Let the robot safely move to a specified room based on the room's unique identifier. If the robot cannot move to the specified room safely, it will return a message indicating the reason why it cannot move to the specified room safely.

parameters.name: room_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the room to which the robot should move.

NortonIdentitySafeAutoFillPersonalInfo.summary: Auto-fill personal information on a specified website.

parameters.name: website
parameters.description: The website to auto-fill the personal information on.

parameters.name: info_type
parameters.description: The type of personal information, must be one of ['address', 'payment'].

NortonIdentitySafeSharePassword.summary: Share a stored password securely with a trusted contact.

parameters.name: website
parameters.description: The website associated with the password to share.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: The username associated with the password to share.

parameters.name: contact_email
parameters.description: The email address of the trusted contact.

ShopifyGetProductDetails.summary: Retrieve product details by the product ID.

parameters.name: product_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the product.

parameters.name: channel_name
parameters.description: The name of the channel, must start with '#'.

TeladocViewReviews.summary: View reviews for a doctor by providing the doctor's unique identifier.

parameters.name: doctor_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the chosen doctor.

TerminalExecute.summary: Execute a terminal command and return the output. This command should follow proper syntax and be supported by the terminal environment.

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: The command to execute in the terminal.

The23andMeShareData.summary: Shares the user's genetic data with a third-party application.

parameters.name: app_id
parameters.description: The identifier of the third-party application. The 'app_id' should be a valid identifier of a registered third-party application.

parameters.name: new_data
parameters.description: The new genetic data for the user. The object includes fields 'ancestry', 'traits', 'health_predispositions', and 'carrier_status'.

TodoistSearchTasks.summary: Searches tasks by keywords, due date, and priority.

parameters.name: keywords
parameters.description: The keywords to search in the task name and description.

parameters.name: due_date
parameters.description: The due date to search tasks in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

parameters.name: priority
parameters.description: The priority to search tasks from 1 (highest) to 4 (lowest).

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: The status of the tasks to search, either 'in progress' or 'completed'.

parameters.name: max_results
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to return. Default value is 10.

TrafficControlGivePriorityToEmergencyVeh.summary: Gives priority to an emergency vehicle by changing vehicle lights at specific intersections.

parameters.name: intersection_ids
parameters.description: The unique identifiers of the intersections where priority should be given.

parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: The start time of the priority period in the format 'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss'.

parameters.name: end_time
parameters.description: The end time of the priority period in the format 'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss'.

TrafficControlManageTrafficLightState.summary: Changes the state of a traffic light at a specific intersection, either immediately, or at a scheduled time.

parameters.name: intersection_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the intersection where the traffic light is located.

parameters.name: traffic_light_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the traffic light to change concatenated by the type and the direction, e.g., 'vehicle-north-south'. The type can be 'vehicle' or 'pedestrian'. Typically there will be two lights per intersection: 'north-south' for the north-south direction and 'east-west' for the east-west direction.

parameters.name: traffic_light_state
parameters.description: The new state of the traffic light, for 'vehicle' lights, can be 'red', 'green', 'yellow', or 'hazard'; for 'pedestrian' lights, can be 'walk', 'stop', or 'flashing'.

parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: The start time of the command in the format 'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss'. If not provided, the command takes effect immediately.

parameters.name: end_time
parameters.description: The end time of the command in the format 'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss'.

TwilioGetReceivedSmsMessages.summary: Retrieve the history of received SMS messages.

parameters.name: from_phone_number
parameters.description: The phone number in E.164 format to retrieve the history for. If not specified, the history for all phone numbers will be retrieved.

parameters.name: datetime_range
parameters.description: A list of two timestamps in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss' to retrieve the history between. If not specified, the history for all timestamps will be retrieved.

parameters.name: keywords
parameters.description: The comma-separated keywords to search for in the message content. If not specified, no keyword filtering will be performed.

parameters.name: max_results
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to retrieve. Optional.

TwitterManagerGetUserProfile.summary: Retrieve the user's own profile or another user's profile information by their ID.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the user to retrieve the profile information for. If not provided, return own profile.

TwitterManagerReadTweet.summary: Read the content of a specific tweet by its ID.

parameters.name: tweet_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the tweet to read.

TwitterManagerSearchTweets.summary: Search for user's own tweets or public tweets containing specific keywords or hashtags.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The query string to search for in tweets.

parameters.name: max_results
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to return, default is 10.

parameters.name: own_tweets
parameters.description: Whether to search only the user's own tweets, default is false.

VenmoWithdrawMoney.summary: Withdraw money from the user's Venmo balance to a linked bank account.

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: The amount of money to withdraw, must be positive.

parameters.name: account_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the linked bank account.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The URL to navigate to.
